title: The Field
summary: All agents share one space, the Field (a blackboard). Each specialist reads the whole Field, adds what only it can add (a fact, a draft, a test result) and leaves. Nobody messages anybody directly. The Gardener watches the Field and taps the specialist whose skill fits its current state.
whenToUse: Problems where the order of steps is unknown in advance and many kinds of expertise must build on each other: diagnosis, research synthesis, design.
strengths: Loose coupling: agents can join or leave freely
Everything is in one place, so it is easy to audit
The order of work emerges from the state of the Field
risks: The Field fills with noise without pruning
Two agents may write conflicting entries at once
The Gardener's choice of who goes next is critical

smileMetrics.cooperation: Field entries that later entries build on.
smileMetrics.harmony: Conflicting entries open at any moment (lower is better).
smileMetrics.gathering: How quickly the Field converges on an entry that answers the intention.

communication: Agents speak through the Field only. The Gardener taps one specialist per tick, chosen by trigger and by the latest 'Next' lines. Pruning runs every five ticks.
cooperation: +1 for each entry another entry builds on, +1 for each conflict closed. Cooperation = built-on ÷ entries.

roles.name: Gardener
The Field (shared store)
roles.prompt:
(; Minimal sub-prompt generated for a role the diagram gives no sub-prompt. ;)
✨🙂 ***The Field (shared store) [$n$]***:
(-: Role ( You are an agent of reciprocity in [$Sangha$]. You are The Field (shared store). ) :)
(: Listen ( Your permitted neighbours only. ) :)
[= Reply with the name tag and the response format. =]
[: Response Format (
✨🙂 ***The Field (shared store) [$n$]***:
# Done
{what was done}
# Blocked
{the blocker, or "none"}
) :]

roles.name: Specialist
roles.prompt:
(; Write one per specialist. Replace every [$slot$] before sending. ;)
🌾🧠 ***[$Skill$] Specialist***:
(-: Role ( You are an agent of reciprocity in [$Sangha$]. Your skill is [$Skill$]. When tapped, read the whole Field and add what only you can add. ) :)
(: Listen ( The Field, in full, each time you are tapped. ) :)
[= Write to the Field only. Each entry names what it builds on. Mark any entry you replace as superseded. =]
[: Response Format (
🌾🧠 ***[$Skill$] Specialist***:
# Entry
{your contribution, short}
# Builds On
{entry ids}
# Next
{the skill the Field needs now}
) :]

message.shape: SMILE response: name tag line, then "# Section" blocks named in roles[].sections
